mapper.sql: pk_id, id, tenant_id, org_id, people_id, workspace_task_id, record_type, source, status, title, summary, planned_at, due_at, assignee_staff_id, contact_channel, contact_result, content_json, cancel_reason, completed_at, completed_by_staff_id, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO followup_record( id, tenant_id, org_id, people_id, workspace_task_id, record_type, source, status, title, summary, planned_at, due_at, assignee_staff_id, contact_channel, contact_result, content_json, cancel_reason, completed_at, completed_by_staff_id, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{orgId}, #{peopleId}, #{workspaceTaskId}, #{recordType}, #{source}, #{status}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{plannedAt}, #{dueAt}, #{assigneeStaffId}, #{contactChannel}, #{contactResult}, #{contentJson}, #{cancelReason}, #{completedAt}, #{completedByStaffId}, #{isDeleted}, #{gmtCreated}, #{gmtModified}, #{gmtDeleted} )
mapper.update: UPDATE followup_record SET status = #{status}, title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, contact_channel = #{contactChannel}, contact_result = #{contactResult}, content_json = #{contentJson}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, completed_by_staff_id = #{completedByStaffId}, assignee_staff_id = COALESCE(assignee_staff_id, #{assigneeStaffId}), gmt_modified = #{gmtModified} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM followup_record WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM followup_record WHERE workspace_task_id = #{workspaceTaskId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(completed_at, gmt_created) DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM followup_record WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND people_id = #{peopleId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'OPEN' AND record_type = 'PERIODIC' ORDER BY gmt_created DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM followup_record WHERE workspace_task_id = #{workspaceTaskId} AND status = 'OPEN' AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY gmt_created DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM followup_record WHERE workspace_task_id = #{workspaceTaskId} AND record_type = #{recordType} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(completed_at, gmt_created) DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT f.pk_id, f.id, f.tenant_id, f.org_id, f.people_id, f.workspace_task_id, f.record_type, f.source, f.status, f.title, f.summary, f.planned_at, f.due_at, f.assignee_staff_id, f.contact_channel, f.contact_result, f.content_json, f.cancel_reason, f.completed_at, f.completed_by_staff_id, f.is_deleted, f.gmt_created, f.gmt_modified, f.gmt_deleted FROM followup_record f
ORDER BY COALESCE(f.completed_at, f.planned_at, f.gmt_created) DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
